findings.evidence: upstream/Physlib/Physlib/Relativity/Fermions/Dirac/GammaMatrices.lean:114 `theorem gammaMatrix_anticomm (v w : Lorentz.Vector) : gammaMatrix v * gammaMatrix w + gammaMatrix w * gammaMatrix v = ...`
findings.fix: Use the upstream term for this conclusion, as in Physlib's `gammaMatrix_anticomm`: e.g. `gammaMatrix_nPlus_anticomm_nMinus`, or spell out both summands.
findings.issue: `gammaMatrix_nPlus_mul_gammaMatrix_nMinus_add` ends in a dangling `_add` that names neither the second summand nor the RHS `2`, and it is exactly the name of `gammaMatrix_nPlus_mul_gammaMatrix_nMinus` (line 161, RHS `2 • P₊`) plus a suffix, so the two read as variants of one statement.

findings.evidence: Mathlib uses the head-outward form for this shape: `Prod.fst_swap`/`Prod.snd_swap` (used e.g. at upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/UnitaryGroup.lean:84-85, Mathlib/Probability/Kernel/Composition/KernelLemmas.lean:67).
findings.fix: Rename to `nPlus_swap`, `nMinus_swap` and update the `simpa only [swap_nPlus, swap_nMinus]` call sites in LightConeProjectors.lean.
findings.issue: `swap_nPlus` and `swap_nMinus` (lines 263, 267) read head-first, while every other lemma in the same new section reads head-outward: `plus_swap`, `minus_swap`, `transverseProj_swap`, `longitudinal_swap`, `transverse_swap` (lines 275-294) and `goodProjector_swap`/`badProjector_swap` in the new file. The LHS is `nPlus (swap L)`, so the name should be `nPlus_swap`.

findings.evidence: upstream/Physlib/.../GammaMatrices.lean:133 `gammaMatrix_mul_self (v) : gammaMatrix v * gammaMatrix v = ⟪v, v⟫ₘ • 1`; LightConeBasis.lean:87,125,205 use the explicit `_eq_zero` suffix for zero-valued equalities.
findings.fix: Suffix the vanishing ones with `_eq_zero` (`gammaMatrix_nPlus_mul_self_eq_zero`, `gammaMatrix_nPlus_mul_goodProjector_eq_zero`, …), matching the adjacent file's `nPlus_nPlus_eq_zero`, `plus_nMinus_eq_zero`, `transverseProj_nPlus_eq_zero`.
findings.issue: Lemmas whose conclusion is `= 0` carry names structurally identical to neighbouring lemmas with non-zero RHS, so the name does not distinguish annihilation from absorption: `gammaMatrix_nPlus_mul_self` (93) and `gammaMatrix_nMinus_mul_self` (99) are `= 0` while Physlib's `gammaMatrix_mul_self` is `⟪v,v⟫ • 1` and `goodProjector_mul_self` (202) is idempotency; `gammaMatrix_nPlus_mul_goodProjector` (223) is `= 0` while `gammaMatrix_nMinus_mul_goodProjector` (235) is `= gammaMatrix L.nMinus`; likewise `gammaMatrix_nMinus_mul_badProjector` (229) vs `gammaMatrix_nPlus_mul_badProjector` (242), and `goodProjector_mul_gammaMatrix_nMinus` (249), `badProjector_mul_gammaMatrix_nPlus` (255), `goodProjector_mul_badProjector` (191), `badProjector_mul_goodProjector` (197).

findings.evidence: Lines 384 and 493 of the same file use `gammaMatrix_sub_smul_one` for the same expression `(gammaMatrix p - m • 1)`.
findings.fix: Name the operator in both, e.g. `badProjector_apply_eq_of_gammaMatrix_sub_smul_one_apply_eq_zero` and `exists_gammaMatrix_sub_smul_one_apply_eq_zero_and_goodProjector_apply_eq`.
findings.issue: `badProjector_apply_eq_of_apply_eq_zero` (407) and `exists_apply_eq_zero_and_goodProjector_apply_eq` (450) refer to the Dirac operator as a bare `apply_eq_zero`, naming no function; the sibling statements spell it out (`gammaMatrix_sub_smul_one_apply_eq_zero_iff` at 384, `finrank_ker_gammaMatrix_sub_smul_one` at 493).

summary: Terminology and namespace use are right (good/bad matches the existing HigherTwist vocabulary; the projectors are dot notation on EpsilonEridani's own LightConeBasis), but several names are incomplete or inconsistent with their siblings: a dangling `_add` for the anticommutator, the reversed `swap_nPlus`/`swap_nMinus`, vanishing products named like non-vanishing ones, and an unnamed Dirac operator in two hypothesis names.
